original_file_name: Lancaster%20County%20Budget%20Book%202024_….pdf (the full name was not recorded when the books were renamed)
edition: Adopted: Resolution No. 91 of 2023 on p4.
layout: Scanned photocopy (169 of 170 pages image-only), read by OCR. Line items from the 'Department Account' reports: General Fund revenue pp99-101, expenditure pp103-120; Other Funds revenue pp160-161, expenditure pp162-168. Checked against the by-department reports (pp7, 9, 159) and the by-account reports (pp8, 10-11). The tables print the new year first ('2024 BUDGET | 2023 BUDGET'). Like the 2025 book it has no line-item department pages; its 'Departmental Budget Summary' pages give category totals with 2022 actuals.

ocr._comment: Rendered at 400 DPI and cleaned with ocr_pages.clean_scan (threshold 140, broken table rules erased): the copy shows the back of each sheet through the paper, and Tesseract's own threshold keeps it. On a sample of 9 table pages, 91% of rows read with a variance that matches, against 87% at 300 DPI and under 5% without cleaning.

_page_order: p111 and p112 are bound in the wrong order: p112 ends with the 'A3100 Facilities Management' heading and its first line, and p111 continues Facilities Management, then starts Court Administration, which p113 continues.
